instruction: Automatically generate and sync subtitles for this video by transcribing the audio in real-time.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because VLC does not have speech-to-text or automatic subtitle generation capabilities. It can display existing subtitle files but cannot transcribe audio or create subtitles automatically.

llm_judge_reasons: The task is correctly identified as infeasible
